content:
The new Apple TV tvOS app doesn't come along every few days, but WordPress has just launched WordPress TV, bringing video content to the big screen.

According to the app description page, WordPress TV is a new way to watch "thousands of free talks, tutorials, and WordCamp session recordings from WordPress meetups and events" on Apple TV.

Here's a detailed introduction to the WordPress TV app:

The video library of the WordPress community, now on your TV. WordPress TV brings the complete WordPress.tv video library to the big screen—featuring thousands of free talks, tutorials, and WordCamp session recordings from WordPress meetups and events around the world. You can sit back on your sofa and learn from the people who build and use WordPress every day. The app is natively developed for Apple TV, making it feel just right to control from the sofa: browse a clean poster-grid interface with the remote, and press play to enjoy smooth full-screen HD videos. Content you can watch includes: session recordings from WordCamp events around the world; covering design, development, business, and content

You can download WordPress TV from the App Store on Apple TV.
